title: The Release Assembly
summary: Jiang Taixu calls the Holy Lands and great clans to an assembly, where 'Gu Feng' is asked to drop his disguise and is revealed as Ye Fan. Taixu declares that killing him would be the same as killing Taixu himself. When the Ji family accuses Ye Fan of stealing the Ancient Void Scripture's secrets, Taixu makes him swear never to share them. The Old Golden-Winged Peng King (Immortal Platform 2nd level) and Yaoguang demand the prodigies Ye Fan sealed, and Taixu orders them all released: Jin Chi, the Yaoguang Holy Son and Holy Maiden, the Zifu disciples, Zi Xia and even a Jiang clansman. When the rivals complain that no Holy Body has ever reached the Four Poles, Ye Fan vows to break through and face them all. Taixu gives him ten million catties of source, and the Feng clan, the Thirteen Great Bandits (one million) and Yaochi (three Ancient Enlightenment Tea leaves) add gifts. Feng Lie of the Feng clan brings three million catties as a dowry for his sister Feng Fenghuang under a match Taixu arranged. Ye Fan refuses the marriage, but after Ye Fan beats him, Feng Lie accepts him as a brother-in-law and leaves the source anyway.
